description: How a QA report links its log and how the log links its stage-evidence document: the report output names the log by (sha256:<hex>) (qa_lane._qa_report), and the last trailer line of the log names the document (gate_runner.format_evidence_trailer). The Python tests rebuild every output and trailer from its inputs; the Rust runtime (state::qa_evidence) parses them.
